Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.report

Class PdfCanvas

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.report.PdfCanvas
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class PdfCanvas extends Object implements AutoCloseable
A helper over PDFBox that draws the parts of the report (heading, sections, tables, bar charts, the pie chart and the footer) and keeps everything within the page limit.
Author:
Reinaldo Singh
